system.roleplaying: Your past is lost to you or otherwise obscured. Others have immense difficulty in keeping track of you.
system.minorTwist: You have a flash of your former life that momentarily distracted you — what was it?
system.majorTwist: A shocking detail of your past changes the current situation — how does it affect the scene?

greenAbility.name: Principle of Amnesia
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome a situation where a completely fresh perspective is useful and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
